title: Home Mortgage Loans: escrow cushion, surplus threshold, shortage spread and analysis frequency

# Home Mortgage Loans: escrow cushion, surplus threshold, shortage spread and analysis frequency

This document lists the escrow analysis settings of every Home Mortgage Loans program: the cushion kept in escrow, the surplus amount that triggers a refund after an analysis, the number of months over which a shortage is collected, and how often escrow is analysed.

## Settings by program

| Program | Escrow cushion (months of disbursements) | Surplus refund threshold (USD) | Shortage collected over (months) | Months between escrow analyses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2 | 50.00 | 12 | 12 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Escrow cushion** is the number of months of escrow disbursements kept as a cushion.
- **Surplus refund threshold** is the escrow surplus at or above which the surplus is refunded after an analysis.
- **Shortage collected over** is the number of months over which an escrow shortage is collected.
- **Months between escrow analyses** is the interval from one escrow analysis to the next.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical surplus amounts)

| Hypothetical surplus found by an analysis | Against the 50.00 threshold |
|---|---|
| 50.00 | At the threshold: meets it |
| 49.99 | Below the threshold |
| 75.00 | Above the threshold: meets it |

## Basis Q&A

- **Do the escrow settings differ between programs?** No. All six programs use the same cushion, surplus threshold, shortage spread and analysis interval.
- **How often is escrow analysed?** Once every 12 months in every program.
